title:
RESTEL STAY
A night of Korean-style rest
lead: Some days a few hours isn't enough. RESTEL STAY stretches the RESTEL way of resting into one night and two days. It will open only at locations registered as lodging.
notice: RESTEL Sinchon, open now, is an hourly rest space rental, so overnight use isn't available there. RESTEL STAY will open separately at licensed lodging locations.
compare: 60 minutes to 8 hours, ending before midnight
RESTEL Sinchon and partner rest spaces
Floor platform, mats and blankets, tea, guided meditation
The RESTEL routine, plus a night’s sleep and a morning tea
Join the list for opening news
flowTitle: A RESTEL STAY night, as we imagine it
flowNote: This is a planned programme and may differ by location.

flow.title: Put the day down with a cup of tea
flow.body: Drop your bags, pour a warm tea and let the pace of the day fall away.

flow.title: Breathing and a warm floor
flow.body: A guided meditation, then lie back in a room with the lights turned low.

flow.title: Barley tea and a slow start
flow.body: Wake to slowly brightening light instead of an alarm, and begin with a cup of nutty barley tea.

flow.title: A short walk, then back to your trip
flow.body: Stroll the neighbourhood and head on, properly rested.

for: Travellers who want one truly quiet night in the middle of a busy trip
Anyone coming to Seoul for a Korean wellness break
People who want a night of real rest, not just somewhere to sleep

faq.q: Can I stay overnight at RESTEL Sinchon now?
faq.a: No. RESTEL Sinchon is an hourly rest space and every session ends before midnight. Overnight rest will be possible once RESTEL STAY opens.

faq.q: When and where will RESTEL STAY open?
faq.a: Location by location, as lodging registration is completed. People on the list hear about dates and places first.
Prices haven’t been set yet. We’ll share them with the opening announcement.
Yes. Like the RESTEL website, RESTEL STAY information and booking are being prepared in many languages.

todayBody: At RESTEL Sinchon you can already book anything from a 60-minute nap to a full day of rest of up to 8 hours.
